facts.fact: The World Bank blog says more than 250,000 households, about 20 percent of the population, are enrolled in the Liberia Household Social Registry, which the Cabinet endorsed in January 2020 as the primary tool for targeting social protection programmes.
The World Bank blog says the LHSR and the MIS are being used by three government-led social protection programmes.
